observation.depicts: Tall narrow launcher panel: search bar, circular textured avatar labelled u/pjackim, six coloured folder buttons, app icons, power buttons, and a George Sheehan quote.
observation.text_readable: "Search...", "u/pjackim", "sudo", "Bin Books Coding Documents Downloads Pictures", "Success means having the courage, the determination, and the will to become the person you believe you were meant to be. - George Sheehan".
observation.composition: Portrait, tall narrow frame filled edge to edge with stacked rounded panels; a thin top bar is cut at the left edge. Quote panel has empty space above and below the text.
observation.tone_and_contrast: Grey-blue translucent background with pastel yellow, teal, green and orange buttons; text on buttons is dark and readable. Moderate overall contrast, colours separate the buttons clearly.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Small pixel-scale render; text edges show mild softness at native size. Avatar shows a repeating scale-like texture. Top bar text "fish /home/pjackim" is clipped at left. No watermark.
observation.scan_first_read: A colourful stack of pastel buttons and a quote; looks like a custom launcher menu, small text unclear.
